findings.claim: ClientPermissionsV2 uses Arrays.asList() for single-element lists where List.of() could be used.

verifier.reason: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:225 and services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:250, both private hasPermission overloads wrap the single non-null scope string with Arrays.asList(scope) only for membership checks, where List.of(scope) (already used at line 266) could be used.
